lessons.key: spec_deviation::when wrapping a third party primitive assert in the rendered dom the a11y attribute the spec names aria live role computing a mapping value is not the same as passing it to the primitive
lessons.text: When wrapping a third-party primitive, assert in the rendered DOM the a11y attribute the spec names (aria-live, role) — computing a mapping value is not the same as passing it to the primitive.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::validate a numeric prop by rejecting invalid input only math max default value silently clamps legitimate values below the default
lessons.text: Validate a numeric prop by rejecting invalid input only; Math.max(default, value) silently clamps legitimate values below the default.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::a test named for a no op must perform the action and assert the state is unchanged asserting only the initial state proves nothing
lessons.text: A test named for a no-op must perform the action and assert the state is unchanged; asserting only the initial state proves nothing.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when an ac says an attribute stays hardcoded keep it written after the props spread moving it to propx default hands precedence to the consumer and is a silent behaviour change
lessons.text: When an AC says an attribute stays hardcoded, keep it written after the props spread; moving it to 'propX ?? default' hands precedence to the consumer and is a silent behaviour change.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec names an exact icon per variant assert which icon renders tobeinthedocument cannot distinguish a scrambled mapping
lessons.text: When a spec names an exact icon per variant, assert which icon renders; toBeInTheDocument cannot distinguish a scrambled mapping.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::if a derived view already truncates a list an eviction side effect on the source state is unobservable assert the source state not only the derived length
lessons.text: If a derived view already truncates a list, an eviction side effect on the source state is unobservable; assert the source state, not only the derived length.

lessons.key: ac_gap::never let a v8 ignore pragma stand in for an acceptance criterion if the ac states an ssr behaviour exercise it with rendertostring
lessons.text: Never let a v8-ignore pragma stand in for an acceptance criterion; if the AC states an SSR behaviour, exercise it with renderToString.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a global test stub that pins one branch makes 100 coverage meaningless for the other assert the mode specific contract per branch with a local stub override
lessons.text: A global test stub that pins one branch makes 100% coverage meaningless for the other; assert the mode-specific contract per branch with a local stub override.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a production fix is not done until a mutation that undoes it fails a test ship the fix and its discriminating assertion in the same commit
lessons.text: A production fix is not done until a mutation that undoes it fails a test; ship the fix and its discriminating assertion in the same commit.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::test a numeric limit prop at a value that differs from the default in both directions a test using the default value cannot detect a clamp
lessons.text: Test a numeric limit prop at a value that differs from the default in both directions; a test using the default value cannot detect a clamp.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::never assert a css rule with a greedy regex across the stylesheet anchor on the exact selector string or a neighbouring rule will satisfy the match
lessons.text: Never assert a CSS rule with a greedy .* regex across the stylesheet; anchor on the exact selector string or a neighbouring rule will satisfy the match.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::radix dialog restores focus only to its own dialog trigger ref a custom trigger outside the dialog needs an explicit oncloseautofocus handler or focus lands on body
lessons.text: Radix Dialog restores focus only to its own Dialog.Trigger ref; a custom trigger outside the Dialog needs an explicit onCloseAutoFocus handler or focus lands on body.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::key a collapsed state css rule on every data attribute the ac names omitting the open closed attribute makes the rule fire in states the spec excludes
lessons.text: Key a collapsed-state CSS rule on every data attribute the AC names; omitting the open/closed attribute makes the rule fire in states the spec excludes.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a component branches on a responsive breakpoint test every collapsible variant mode on both sides of the breakpoint not just the default one
lessons.text: When a component branches on a responsive breakpoint, test every collapsible/variant mode on BOTH sides of the breakpoint, not just the default one

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a css contract test that pins a selector must be paired with a component test asserting the element actually carries that class
lessons.text: A CSS-contract test that pins a selector must be paired with a component test asserting the element actually carries that class

lessons.key: ac_gap::every invalid input edge case listed in the spec needs its own test 100 branch coverage does not imply the guard s rejected values were exercised
lessons.text: Every invalid-input edge case listed in the spec needs its own test; 100% branch coverage does not imply the guard's rejected values were exercised

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec fixes a default prop value assert that literal with the prop omitted not only that an explicitly passed override works
lessons.text: When the spec fixes a default prop value, assert that literal with the prop omitted, not only that an explicitly-passed override works

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::for an aria id reference aria controls aria labelledby assert the referenced id resolves to the intended element not just that the attribute is non empty
lessons.text: For an ARIA id reference (aria-controls, aria-labelledby), assert the referenced id resolves to the intended element, not just that the attribute is non-empty

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::re check each v8 ignore pragma against the suite a pragma that can be removed without breaking the coverage threshold is masking a path that is already tested
lessons.text: Re-check each v8-ignore pragma against the suite; a pragma that can be removed without breaking the coverage threshold is masking a path that is already tested
